name: Grand SPA Resort A-ROSA Kitzbühel
beschreibung: The Grand SPA Resort A-ROSA Kitzbühel is located in the town of Kitzbühel in Tirol. It is a five-star hotel with a spacious spa and wellness area. The spa spans several floors and includes various saunas, steam baths, and swimming pools. Several restaurants offer regional and international dishes. The rooms and suites are modernly furnished and have a balcony or terrace. The resort is a good starting point in both winter and summer for activities such as skiing, hiking, and golf. The hotel also offers childcare and a fitness area.
